title: Yara and the Choir
author: Gideon Pemberton
blurb: Marguerite Okonkwo, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
